$comment: Modern Campus component instance (~[com[ID ...{json}]]~) -> Storyblok blok, for the migration script.
Field hashes are Modern Campus field IDs (not derivable from names); mapped from sample values across C:/development/mc-sites and checked against published usu.edu pages where marked.

Each entry's 'unknown' lists hashes seen only empty, so they can't be identified yet.
